view.name: Conversion result
view.description: After pasting rich text, the converter shows a 'Converted pasted.md' header with Copy Markdown / Download .md / Convert another file actions and side-by-side Markdown source and rendered preview panels.

regions.label: Minimal top bar with 'w2m' chip logo and serif wordmark 'Word to Markdown', no nav
Centered mono eyebrow, mixed-typeface H1, subtitle with inline code, .docx → .md file-chip illustration, 'Converting docs since 2014'
'Converted pasted.md' heading with Copy Markdown (primary lime), Download .md, Convert another file buttons
Two side-by-side bordered panels: MARKDOWN source (monospace) and rendered PREVIEW, each internally scrolling
Post-conversion maker note 'Nice — one more doc out of Word…' with 'See Open & Async →' link
Language link list (20 locales, globe icon), site links row, mono tagline 'Converted in your browser · nothing is uploaded'

evidence.note: Left pane: raw Markdown source in JetBrains Mono, scrolls internally (~480px tall at 900px viewport)
Right pane: rendered preview of the same converted document; panes are fixed equal widths, no divider

patterns.rationale: Capture shows the post-conversion state; the drop zone only appears after clicking 'Convert another file' (verified live), so the upload entry is not visible in the capture itself.

evidence.note: Returns to a .docx drop zone ('Drop your .docx here or click to choose a file', Up to 20 MB) — seen live, not in capture
Result of the file/paste hand-off; extracted contents shown as Markdown
Markdown pane is read-only <code> output, no syntax colouring, gutter or editing

evidence.quote: Nice — one more doc out of Word and into the open.
evidence.note: Outlined callout is a promotional maker note, not a condition requiring attention; conversion status is screen-reader-only
'Conversion complete' exists only as an aria status live region; no visible transient message
Static two-column reference table rendered inside the preview pane as document content; no sorting/filtering/actions

structure.layout: single-column centered tool page: minimal header, centered hero, result toolbar above a fixed two-pane Markdown source/preview split (internally scrolling), promo callout, centered footer with language links

aesthetics.typography: Hanken Grotesk for body, buttons, subtitle and footer links; Fraunces (serif, italic in 'Word') for wordmark, H2 'Converted' and preview headings; JetBrains Mono for eyebrow, 'Markdown' in H1, file chips, pane labels, Markdown source and footer tagline
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast: 72px/600 H1 mixing three faces, 20px subtitle, 18px serif H2, 14px buttons/body in panes, 10–13px letter-spaced mono eyebrows and labels

notes: Warm off-white paper background with a faint dot-grid texture near the top. Signature H1 sets 'Word' in italic Fraunces serif, 'to' in muted grotesk, 'Markdown' in JetBrains Mono — literally expressing the conversion from document to code. Acid-lime (#d0d820) primary button and file chip, olive (#646a00) for eyebrow text and link underlines. Hero has a mini '.docx → .md' chip diagram. Capture is the post-conversion state (the page converted its own HTML as 'pasted.md'); the drop zone, 3-step 'Drop/Convert/Copy or save' strip and dark navy book promo card only appear in the empty state (seen live). The two result panes are fixed-height internally scrolling panels with small dot + mono uppercase labels (lime dot for MARKDOWN, slate dot for PREVIEW). Footer is a localization link list of 20 languages plus a site-links row; no codebook entry for a language switcher link list.
